files.MIGRATIONS.md:
# Migrations

Migrations run in filename order. A merged migration is never edited: every schema change is a new numbered file.
files.migrations/0001_create_customers.sql: CREATE TABLE customers (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL);
files.migrations/0002_create_orders.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id TEXT REFERENCES customers(id), total NUMERIC NOT NULL);

files.migrations/0003_add_order_status.sql: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new';

files.src/checkout/index.js:
const flags = require('../../config/flags.json');

module.exports = flags.checkout_v2 ? require('./v2') : require('./v1');

constraints.description: The schema change goes in a new migration (0004): migrations run in filename order and a merged migration is never edited.
Checkout has two paths chosen by the checkout_v2 flag (off), so the gift message must work in v1 and v2 or be gated.
